unit: 所有 單 位 All units
terms: 港幣 6,000,000 於簽署臨時買賣合約時繳付作為臨時訂金。 港幣 14,380,000 於2026年 5月19日或之前繳付作為加付訂金。 成交金額的餘額於2027年 1月28日或之前繳付。 (《一手住宅物業銷售條例》(「第 621 章」)第63(1)及63(2)及/或63(3)條的例外情況適用於本交 易，因此賣方無須遵守第 621 章第 2 部第 2、3、4、5、6 及7分部的規定。) HK$6,000,000 shall be paid upon signing of the preliminary agreement for sale and purchase as deposit. HK$14,380,000 shall be paid on or before 19/05/2026 as further deposit. Balance of transaction price shall be paid on or before 28/01/2027. (The exceptions under section 63(1) and sections 63(2) and/or 63(3) of the Residential Properties (First- hand Sales) Ordinance ("Cap.621") apply to this transaction and so that the Vendor is not required to comply with the requirements under Divisions 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 of Part 2 of Cap.621.)
